prompt:
A music-video still, 16:9, a winter dusk in 1920s New York. A robber called BOTTLE leans on the peeling green door frame of a brick tenement and raps straight into an ultrawide lens set low and close, one gloved finger jabbing at the camera. His bottle-green hand-knitted rib-wool balaclava covers his whole head and neck and tucks into his turned-up collar, with smooth unbroken knit where the face would be. An oatmeal ring is chain-stitched round it like the outline of a face, and a small red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high over his right eye, on the left of the picture. He wears a brown tweed suit and black leather gloves. Beside him, a fat landlord in a fur-collared overcoat and bowler holds his palm out to a gaunt man and wife in worn coats in the dim hallway. Grey snow-light from the street, wet cobbles, coarse film grain.

Thanks.
